releasenotes: Faster lists in the REST API, the mobile app among others (posts of a topic, the list of topics, Pages records). IPS asked the database about the reactions, tags and rating of every record of a page on its own: 73 queries (about 70 ms) per list of Pages records on the forum we measured. The reactions and tags of a whole page now come with one query made of IPS's own queries, so every record gets exactly what IPS would read for it, and IPS's own code still builds every record. On a test database: a page of 25 posts 27 -> 3 queries, a list of 35 Pages records 106 -> 38. Separate switch in the settings.
